name: Greatclub of the Scrag
upgradeable: Epic Crafting to Epic Greatclub of the Scrag

effects.name: Enhancement Bonus
effects.tooltip: +3 Enhancement Bonus : +3 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls .

effects.name: Anarchic
effects.tooltip: Anarchic 2 : This weapon is chaotic and used to undermine the righteous, dealing an additional 2d6 chaos damage on each hit. This effect makes the weapon chaotic aligned. (Lawful characters wielding this weapon will suffer one negative level .)

effects.name: Chilling
effects.tooltip: Chilling 2 : This effect causes the edges of this weapon to become frozen to the touch, dealing 2d6 Ice damage on each hit.

effects.name: Regeneration
effects.tooltip: Regeneration : Causes the wearer to regenerate 1 hit point a minute using positive energy.

flavor_text: This particularly nasty weapon once belonged to one of the Scrag in High Priestess' Slikir's service. It seems that when the troll was killed, its blood seeped into this club, granting the weapon some of the creature's characteristics.

source.raw: Altar of Vulkoor , Cleansed version of Dampened Greatclub of the Scrag
